units.source_text: 她一时呆立不动，耸起了肩膀，

en.t: For a moment she stood there blankly, her shoulders drawn up,

units.source_text: 马上又谦和地弯下腰，正要郑重地寒暄。

en.t: then immediately bent down modestly, just about to offer a formal greeting.

units.source_text: 这时他笑了起来，冒冒失失地靠近过去，

en.t: At that moment he began to laugh and went up to her impetuously,

units.source_text: 学着洋式的礼节同她握手。

en.t: imitating Western etiquette as he shook her hand.
